text:
Fit Coach does one job. You tell it how you feel and when you last trained. It picks today's session and writes the work. Eat meat. Train. Remain dangerous.
Template: https://x.ai/bot/029xyNepam5LGMNYLIDP8
What it does
You report two things. How the body feels. When you last trained. Fit Coach reads that and assigns one of four sessions.
Heavy. Strength. Load on the bar. Slow, hard, controlled.
Power. Explosive. Move the weight fast. Quality over grind.
Speed. Fast work. Conditioning that still leaves the joints intact.
Recover. The session most men skip and then wonder why they stall.
It writes the session for you. You do not pick the day off a spreadsheet you made in January and ignored.
What it is not
It is not a doctor. It is not a physical therapist. It is not a meal plan, a supplement pitch, or a 12-week transformation funnel.
It does not shame a missed day. Missed days are data. You say when you last trained. It builds from that.
How to use it
Open the bot. Say how you feel. Say the last session. Get today's work. Do the work. Come back tomorrow and tell it the truth again.
That is the whole system. Heavy, power, speed, recover. Repeat.
I built it the same way I talk about training. Stop making it complicated. Train the quality you actually need. Then recover and do it again.
